infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Citizen Monitor uses your camera so you can capture election evidence, signed result sheets, and incident reports.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Citizen Monitor uses your photo library so you can attach election photos and videos from your gallery.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Citizen Monitor uses your microphone when recording live incident videos and cumulative result announcement videos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Citizen Monitor uses your location to verify that reports and evidence are submitted from the correct polling area.
